summary: Ryot is a self-hosted personal dashboard designed to track various facets of your daily life, such as media consumption and fitness routines. It provides a centralised interface to log and monitor personal data using containerised infrastructure. The project is open-source under the GPL-3.0 licence and maintains an active community base on GitHub.
goodFor: It is a suitable tool if you want a dedicated, private space to aggregate your personal statistics and lifestyle metrics without relying on third-party cloud services.
watchOut: The codebase has a moderate maintenance health score, meaning you should be prepared to handle potential bugs or slower update cycles for niche features.
deployNotes: Because it runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
